_about: Visa statuses for the Visa-Clock on the home screen. Facts only from the official pages listed in each status's sources; checked on the date below. propelo/visaclock.py and the dashboard (synced by scripts/sync_visa_rules.py) read this file and must agree; tests compare them.

notes.missing: Add your dates in Settings to start the clock.
notes.over: This date has passed. Check your dates in Settings.
notes.overDays: No days are left. Get advice today from your school's DSO or an immigration adviser.
notes.paused: Paused while you have a job.
notes.counting: Counting each day without a job since {date}.
notes.startsOn: Your OPT starts on {date}. The count begins then.
notes.jobEnded: Your job ended on {date}. The grace period ends on {end}.

working.label: I have a job on OPT now

daysUsed.label: Unemployment days used so far
daysUsed.hint: Leave empty to count from your OPT start date

jobEnded.label: Last day of your job, if it has ended

us-campus: On campus: up to 20 hours a week while school is in session, and full-time during breaks. Off-campus work needs CPT or OPT.
us-cpt: Off campus: only the employer and dates your CPT authorisation names. On campus: up to 20 hours a week while school is in session.
us-opt: OPT work must be directly related to your major, for at least 20 hours a week.
us-h1b: You can work for the employer that filed your H-1B petition.
uk-student: Up to 20 hours a week in term time at degree level, and full-time in vacations.
Your course has ended, so full-time work is allowed until your visa ends.
uk-free: You can work in most jobs, for any employer, while your Graduate visa lasts.
uk-sponsored: You work for the employer that sponsors your visa.
ie-stamp2: Up to 20 hours a week now. From June to September, and from 15 December to 15 January, up to 40 hours a week.
Up to 40 hours a week now (June to September, and 15 December to 15 January). Up to 20 hours a week at other times.
ie-free: You can work full-time for any employer without an employment permit.
nl-study: Up to 16 hours a week, or full-time in June, July and August. Your employer needs a work permit (TWV) for you.
Full-time work is allowed now (June to August). Your employer needs a work permit (TWV) for you.
nl-free: You can work for any employer without a work permit (TWV).

statuses.label: F-1 student
badge: days left in your 60-day grace period
statuses.next: Ask your DSO about post-completion OPT before your program ends. OPT gives up to 12 months of work in your field. After your program end date you have 60 days to leave, start OPT, transfer or change status.
sources: Study in the States: the 60-day grace period

statuses.label: F-1 on CPT
badge: days left in your 60-day grace period
statuses.next: Ask your DSO about post-completion OPT before your program ends. OPT gives up to 12 months of work in your field.

statuses.label: OPT (after graduation)
statuses.next: If your degree is on the STEM list, a job with an employer enrolled in E-Verify can extend OPT by 24 months. File for the extension before your OPT card ends.
sources: Study in the States: the unemployment counter

statuses.label: STEM OPT extension

labels.daysUsed: Unemployment days used so far, including on OPT

statuses.next: Each STEM OPT employer must be enrolled in E-Verify. The 150 days include the ones you used on OPT.
sources: Study in the States: the unemployment counter

statuses.label: H-1B

labels.permitEnd: H-1B end date (on your I-797 or I-94)

badge: days until your H-1B end date
days left in your 60-day grace period
statuses.next: If your job ends, you have up to 60 days, or until your H-1B end date if that is sooner, for a new employer to file a petition for you.
sources: USCIS: options after a job ends

statuses.label: Student visa

labels.permitEnd: Student visa end date (on your eVisa)

badge: days left to switch from your Student visa
statuses.next: If you switch to a Skilled Worker visa from your Student visa, the employer pays no Immigration Skills Charge, which is otherwise up to £1,320 for the first year. You can apply once your course is complete, or earlier if the job starts after your course ends. A Graduate visa must also be applied for before your Student visa ends.
sources: GOV.UK: switch to a Skilled Worker visa
UKCISA: working on a Student visa

statuses.label: Graduate visa

labels.permitEnd: Graduate visa end date (on your eVisa)

badge: days left on your Graduate visa
statuses.next: A Graduate visa can't be extended. To stay, switch to a Skilled Worker visa with a licensed sponsor before it ends. It lasts 2 years if you applied by 31 December 2026, 18 months if you apply from 1 January 2027, and 3 years after a PhD.
sources: GOV.UK: switch to a Skilled Worker visa

statuses.label: Skilled Worker visa
badge: days left on your Skilled Worker visa
statuses.next: Roles from employers on the Home Office register of licensed sponsors are marked, so you can see who could sponsor a move.

statuses.label: Stamp 2 (student)

labels.permitEnd: Stamp 2 end date (on your IRP card)

statuses.next: Once you have your results, apply for Stamp 1G (the Third Level Graduate Programme) within six months, while your Stamp 2 is still valid.
sources: Workplace Relations Commission: Stamp 2 working hours
Irish Immigration: Third Level Graduate Programme

statuses.label: Stamp 1G (graduate)

labels.permitEnd: Stamp 1G end date (on your IRP card)

statuses.next: Stamp 1G lasts 12 months after a level 8 degree, and up to 24 months in total after level 9 or above. To stay longer, a job can lead to a Critical Skills or General Employment Permit.
sources: Irish Immigration: Third Level Graduate Programme

statuses.label: Study residence permit
badge: days left on your residence permit
statuses.next: Within three years of graduating you can apply for the orientation year (zoekjaar). It lasts one year and lets you work for any employer without a work permit.
sources: EU Immigration Portal: students in the Netherlands

statuses.label: Orientation year (zoekjaar), including top-200 graduates
badge: days left in your orientation year
statuses.next: The orientation year lasts one year and can't be extended. Before it ends, a job can lead to a work permit such as the highly skilled migrant permit.

statuses.label: Not living in one of these countries yet
statuses.next: Roles from employers with a record of sponsoring visas come first, and roles that say they can't sponsor are left out.

statuses.label: Citizen or settled, no visa needed
